about: The expected values of the attested ice sheet input-output balance this package runs, one entry per run.
Every number here is quoted from the Reference run section of the concept named in `concept`, and was
reproduced at these paths when the computation moved into this package on 2026-09-20.
The concept owns these numbers; the golden exists so a run that stops reproducing what the concept
records fails the gate, not so that a number can be asserted here.
A run identifier is bound to the runtime name, the package block and the package-relative data root,
so it is deliberately not asserted; the values below are the same under any runtime name.
The record run on the committed root refuses and is asserted as a refusal rather than as a number:
the root carries the real gate velocities and no thickness term, so no real-data estimate by this
method exists yet and the fixture chain is what proves the method.

refusals.about: The committed root carries the velocity term and nothing else: BedMachine is distributed only from a host this environment's egress policy refuses, and no NASA archive distributes a grounded Greenland surface mass balance. The refusal is a finding about access and distribution, not an error.
